answer: The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 761 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the dawn. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the prism queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. A 251 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
